name: Progressive Volume Distillation
definition: A systematic distillation method that allows any-to-any conversions between different NeRF architectures (MLP, sparse tensors, low-rank tensors, hashtables) by performing distillation progressively on different levels of volume representations, from shallower to deeper.
summary: Progressive Volume Distillation converts Neural Radiance Field models between heterogeneous architectures by progressively distilling from shallower to deeper levels, enabling any-to-any conversion while maintaining teacher performance.
